summary: Editorial 1440x960 bento CV web application for Sveta Blekher tailored to the ElevenLabs Marketplace Operations (Productions) role, featuring a multilingual localizable voice-note pitch (EN/HE RTL/RU/ES) with swappable per-language audio, click-to-upload avatar with editorial monogram, six career-focused live bento cards on a unified motion clock, and a full printable CV drawer.
